items.title: Prediction of Long-Term Postsurgical Seizure Recurrence From MRI Brain Hub Disruption in Patients With Temporal Lobe Epilepsy.
items.abstract: Patients with temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) can achieve seizure freedom in the early period after surgery, yet up to half experience seizure recurrence in the following years (i.e., long-term). TLE is associated with disruption of highly connected brain regions (hubs), which may reduce the likelihood of long-term surgical success. We tested whether disruption of physiologic (normative) hubs predicts long-term seizure outcomes. In a prospective, multimodal cohort of patients with drug-resistant TLE from 6 centers who underwent resective or laser ablative surgery and had more than 2 years of follow-up (mean = 5.4 years, SD = 3.2 years), we derived structural and functional connectomes from preoperative diffusion-weighted MRI and resting-state fMRI. Using a large multicenter healthy-control cohort, we identified normative connector hubs and quantified patient-specific disruption within these hubs using the graph-theory measure-participation coefficient. To classify seizure-free (positive class) and non-seizure-free (negative class) outcomes, we trained machine learning models using patient-specific disruption of the participation coefficient derived from structural and functional connectomes and their combination (multimodal approach). We evaluated model performance in an independent cohort. Models further incorporated clinical and demographic variables, as well as gray and white matter volumes. In our cohort of 175 patients, the multimodal approach outperformed a model based on clinical and demographic variables only and unimodal approaches, achieving high specificity (mean = 80.0%, SD = 9.9%) and moderate-to-high negative predictive value (mean = 63.9%, SD = 3.6%). Using 362 healthy controls to define normative connector hubs, Shapley Additive Explanation analyses identified disruption of the participation coefficient in the hippocampi and connector hubs of the dorsal attention network as predictive of long-term seizure recurrence, which includes areas not typically targeted in TLE surgery. Disruption of normative hub architecture provides biologically interpretable biomarkers of long-term seizure outcomes in TLE. Contrary to previous studies, the model achieved high specificity in predicting long-term seizure recurrence, which supports its potential clinical utility for postoperative risk stratification and counseling rather than surgical exclusion. By validating performance in an independent cohort under conservative evaluation, our study underscores the translational potential of network-level biomarkers to complement conventional predictors.
items.summary_ja:
背景：側頭葉てんかん（TLE）患者は手術後早期に発作が消失しても、長期的には約半数が再発する。TLEは脳の高連結領域（ハブ）の機能障害と関連し、これが長期的な手術成功率を低下させる可能性がある。  
方法：6施設からの薬物抵抗性TLE患者175名を対象に、術前の拡散強調MRIと安静時fMRIから構造的・機能的コネクトームを作成。362名の健常者データを用いて基準となるハブを特定し、患者ごとのハブ障害度をグラフ理論の参加係数で評価。機械学習モデルにより、ハブ障害度と臨床・人口統計学的データを組み合わせて長期発作再発の予測を試みた。独立コホートでモデル性能を検証。  
結果：多モーダルモデルは臨床情報のみや単一モーダルモデルを上回り、特異度80.0％、陰性的中率63.9％を達成。海馬や背側注意ネットワークのハブ障害が長期発作再発の予測因子として特定された。これらは従来の手術対象外の領域を含む。  
結論：基準ハブの障害はTLEの長期発作再発を予測する生物学的に解釈可能なバイオマーカーとなりうる。高い特異度により、術後リスク層別化や患者指導への臨床応用が期待される。独立コホートでの検証により、ネットワークレベルの指標が従来の予測因子を補完する可能性が示された。
items.summary_short_ja: 側頭葉てんかん患者において、術後早期は発作消失しても長期的には約半数が再発する。術前MRIから得た構造・機能的脳ネットワークのハブ破壊度を機械学習で解析し、長期発作再発を高精度に予測可能であることを示した。特に海馬や注意ネットワークのハブ破壊が重要で、従来の臨床指標を上回る特異度を持つため、術後リスク評価や患者指導に有用なバイオマーカーとなる。

items.title: Association Between Menopausal Hormone Therapy and Alzheimer Disease Neuropathology.
items.abstract: Although evidence suggests that the neurophysiologic impact of estrogen decline during menopause may contribute to increased risk of Alzheimer disease (AD) in women, the effect of menopausal hormonal therapy (MHT) on AD risk requires further study. We sought to examine the associations between MHT use and neuropathologic, clinical, and imaging/fluid biomarker outcomes. In this cohort study, we tested the association between estrogen-only MHT use and dementia outcomes in female participants using 2 independent, large-scale data sets: National Alzheimer's Coordinating Center (NACC) and Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). Participants included women 50 years and older with self-reported use of estrogen-only MHT or no self-reported use of MHT. Clinical, imaging/fluid biomarker, and neuropathologic outcomes were examined. Research was performed at academic medical centers. Neuropathologic data were collected from NACC for 258 MHT users (mean age of death = 81.9, SD = 19.5) and 2,701 non-MHT users (mean age of death = 82.2, SD = 11.0). The ADNI cohort included 110 MHT users (mean age = 76.5, SD = 7.5) and 1,948 non-MHT users (mean age = 73.2, SD = 8.9). The odds of increased AD pathology on autopsy (primary outcome) were significantly decreased in MHT users relative to nonusers (odds ratio [OR] 0.65, 95% CI 0.48-0.88,  Our findings demonstrate small but significant associations between MHT use during later life and a range of AD-related neuropathologic and clinical outcomes in 2 large cohorts of female participants. Although our results do not address causality and have limited generalizability due to the retrospective nature of the study, they suggest a protective effect of MHT use in the dementia course.
items.summary_ja:
背景：閉経期のエストロゲン低下が女性のアルツハイマー病（AD）リスク増加に関与すると示唆されているが、閉経ホルモン療法（MHT）がADリスクに与える影響は不明確である。  
方法：50歳以上の女性を対象に、エストロゲン単独のMHT使用者と非使用者を比較し、2つの大規模データセット（NACCおよびADNI）を用いて臨床、画像・バイオマーカー、神経病理学的アウトカムを検討した。NACCでは258人のMHT使用者と2,701人の非使用者、ADNIでは110人のMHT使用者と1,948人の非使用者が含まれた。  
結果：剖検によるAD病理の増加リスクはMHT使用者で有意に低く（オッズ比0.65、95%信頼区間0.48-0.88）、臨床的および神経病理学的指標にも小さいが有意な関連が認められた。  
結論：後年期のMHT使用はAD関連の神経病理学的および臨床的アウトカムに対して保護的効果を示唆するが、因果関係の証明や一般化には限界がある。
items.summary_short_ja: 閉経後の女性におけるエストロゲン単独のホルモン療法（MHT）使用とアルツハイマー病（AD）神経病理学的変化の関連を、大規模コホートで検討した。MHT使用者は非使用者に比べてAD病理の増加リスクが有意に低く（OR 0.65）、神経病理学的および臨床的指標においても保護的効果が示唆された。ただし因果関係は不明であり、後ろ向き研究のため一般化には注意が必要である。

items.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
items.abstract: Blood-based biomarkers (BBMs) for Alzheimer disease (AD) have accelerated the prospect of earlier and more accessible detection of AD pathology, potentially beyond specialist settings. However, their introduction in primary care raises important questions about clinical sequencing, interpretability, pathway consequences, and real-world utility. In this Personal View, we argue that the main barrier to responsible implementation is not analytical performance alone, but the absence of a sufficiently defined diagnostic infrastructure in which a test result has a clear and actionable role. In low-prevalence and clinically heterogeneous primary care populations, inadequate clinical anchoring and unstable pretest probability may undermine interpretability and promote category drift from diagnostic testing towards case-finding or quasiscreening. Moreover, the value of a rule-out strategy depends on whether a negative result meaningfully changes management. Until stronger evidence, clearer guidance, and appropriate service conditions are in place, primary care use of AD BBMs should remain selective, clinically anchored, and pathway-dependent.
items.summary_ja:
背景：アルツハイマー病（AD）の血液バイオマーカー（BBMs）は、専門医以外の場でも早期かつ容易な病態検出を可能にする期待が高まっている。  
方法：本論文は、プライマリケアにおけるBBMs導入の課題を、臨床的シーケンスや解釈性、診療経路への影響、実用性の観点から検討したパーソナルビューである。  
結果：プライマリケアの低有病率かつ臨床的に多様な集団では、診断的基盤の不十分さや事前確率の不安定さが解釈を困難にし、診断検査から症例発見や準スクリーニングへのカテゴリーのずれを招く可能性が示された。また、陰性結果による管理方針の変化がなければ、除外戦略の価値は限定的である。  
結論：解析性能だけでなく、検査結果が明確かつ実行可能な役割を持つ診断インフラの整備が不可欠であり、十分なエビデンスや明確な指針、適切なサービス体制が整うまでは、プライマリケアでのAD BBMsの使用は選択的かつ臨床的に根拠のある経路に依存すべきである。
items.summary_short_ja: アルツハイマー病（AD）の血液バイオマーカー（BBMs）は早期診断の可能性を広げるが、一次医療での導入には診断インフラの未整備が課題である。低頻度かつ多様な患者層では検査結果の解釈が困難で、診断からスクリーニング的利用への逸脱も懸念される。陰性結果の臨床的意義も明確でないため、現時点では一次医療でのBBMs使用は限定的かつ明確な診療経路に基づくべきである。

items.title: Intervention or Conservative Management for Symptomatic Cerebral Cavernous Malformations: A Prospective, Population-Based Cohort Study.
items.abstract: There is ongoing clinical equipoise regarding the optimal treatment strategy for symptomatic cerebral cavernous malformations (CCMs). The aim of this study was to estimate the causal effect between CCM intervention (microsurgical resection or stereotactic radiosurgery) and clinical outcomes during long-term follow-up. This population-based cohort study included patients (aged 16 years or older) newly diagnosed with CCM using brain MRI or pathology in Scotland during 1999-2003 or 2006-2010. Using Cox regression analysis, we evaluated associations between CCM intervention (as a time-dependent covariate) and a primary outcome of persistent functional impairment or death (defined as at least 2 consecutive annual Oxford Handicap Scale [OHS] scores of ≥2, with sensitivity analysis of OHS scores ≥3), a composite of symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage or new persistent/progressive nonhemorrhagic focal neurologic deficit (ICH/FND) definitely/possibly related to CCM or CCM intervention, and epileptic seizure(s) definitely/possibly related to CCM during prospective follow-up. Among 306 patients with CCM, 190 were symptomatic (89 [47%] because of ICH/FND and 101 [53%] because of epileptic seizure(s), median age 40 years [interquartile range (IQR) 31-55], and 95 [50%] women). During a median follow-up of 16 years (IQR 14-21, completeness 95%), 37 (19%) patients underwent CCM intervention (n = 35 microsurgical resection and n = 2 stereotactic radiosurgery); they were younger (median 33 [26-40] vs 43 [32-59] years,  CCM intervention for symptomatic CCM was associated with persistent functional dependence or death during long-term follow-up. This may be explained by ICH/FND definitely related to CCM or CCM intervention. These findings should be investigated in a definitive randomized controlled trial.
items.summary_ja:
背景：症候性脳海綿状血管奇形（CCM）の最適治療法については未だ臨床的に意見が分かれている。  
方法：スコットランドで1999-2003年および2006-2010年に新規診断された16歳以上のCCM患者306名（うち症候性190名）を対象に、介入（顕微手術または定位放射線手術）と臨床転帰の因果関係を前向きコホート研究で検討した。主要評価項目は持続的機能障害または死亡で、Cox回帰分析を用いて介入の影響を評価した。中央値16年の追跡期間中、37名が介入を受けた。  
結果：介入群は非介入群より若年であったが、介入は持続的機能障害または死亡と有意に関連した。この関連は、CCMまたは介入に起因する症候性頭蓋内出血や新規・進行性の神経局所症状によって説明される可能性が示唆された。  
結論：症候性CCMに対する介入は長期的に機能依存や死亡リスクの増加と関連しており、この結果は無作為化比較試験での検証が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、症候性脳海綿状血管奇形（CCM）に対する介入治療（顕微外科的切除または定位放射線手術）と保存的管理の長期的な臨床転帰を比較した。306例中190例が症候性で、16年間の追跡で19％が介入を受けた。介入群は若年であったが、持続的な機能障害または死亡のリスクが高く、これはCCMや介入に関連する頭蓋内出血や神経障害によると考えられる。最適治療法の確定には無作為化試験が必要である。

items.title: Individualized vs Standard Blood Pressure Control During Thrombectomy for Ischemic Stroke: The DETERMINE Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.abstract: Current recommended blood pressure (BP) targets during mechanical thrombectomy (MT) rely on a one-size-fits-all approach aiming at preventing hypertension. The efficacy and safety of an individualized BP control during thrombectomy for ischemic stroke has not been well studied. We aimed to evaluate whether an individualized BP control during MT could improve functional outcome at 90 days. We conducted a multicenter, open-label, blinded-endpoint, randomized clinical trial at 8 academic comprehensive stroke centers in France. Adult patients with an acute ischemic stroke due to an anterior large vessel occlusion and an indication for MT were eligible. Recruitment was performed between March 10, 2021, and September 18, 2023. Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to an individualized BP group during MT (where the mean arterial pressure [MAP] was maintained within 10% of the first MAP measured before MT) or a control BP group (systolic BP maintained within 140 and 180 mm Hg). The primary outcome was favorable functional outcome, defined as a modified Rankin Scale score between 0 and 2 at 90 days. Safety outcomes included symptomatic intracranial hemorrhages at 24 hours and mortality at 90 days. Overall, 433 patients (median age, 69.3 years, 228 females [52.8%]) were assigned to an individualized BP group (n = 215) or the control BP group (n = 218); one was excluded because of consent withdrawal. No significant differences in mean BP levels or BP variability were observed between groups during the procedure. Favorable functional outcome at 90 days was observed in 94 patients (44.2%) in the individualized BP group and 106 patients (48.8%) in the control group (adjusted odds ratio, 0.82; 95% CI 0.54-1.24;  In patients with acute ischemic stroke due to an anterior large vessel occlusion, an individualized BP management during MT did not increase rates of favorable functional outcome at 90 days compared with a standard BP management. ClinicalTrials.gov, DETERMINE, number NCT04352296. This study provides Class II evidence that in patients undergoing mechanical thrombectomy for stroke due to anterior large vessel occlusion, functional outcomes at 90 days were similar with individualized BP management and standard BP management.
items.summary_ja:
背景：虚血性脳卒中に対する機械的血栓除去術（MT）中の血圧管理は、現行のガイドラインで一律の目標値が推奨されているが、個別化血圧管理の有効性と安全性は十分に検証されていない。  
方法：フランスの8つの包括的脳卒中センターで、多施設共同の無作為化臨床試験を実施。前方大血管閉塞による急性虚血性脳卒中患者433名を対象に、MT中の平均動脈圧（MAP）を術前値の±10％に維持する個別化血圧管理群（215名）と、収縮期血圧を140～180mmHgに維持する標準管理群（218名）に1:1で割り付けた。主要評価項目は90日後の修正Rankinスケール0～2の良好な機能的転帰。  
結果：両群間で手技中の平均血圧や血圧変動に有意差はなく、90日後の良好な機能的転帰は個別化群44.2％、標準群48.8％で差は認められなかった（調整オッズ比0.82、95％CI 0.54-1.24）。安全性指標にも差はなかった。  
結論：前方大血管閉塞による急性虚血性脳卒中患者のMT中において、個別化血圧管理は標準的血圧管理と比較して90日後の機能的転帰を改善しなかった。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性前方大血管閉塞による虚血性脳卒中患者を対象に、機械的血栓除去術（MT）中の血圧管理を個別化（術前平均動脈圧の±10％維持）と標準管理（収縮期血圧140～180mmHg維持）で比較した多施設ランダム化試験。90日後の機能的良好転帰（修正Rankinスケール0～2）に有意差はなく、安全性も同等であった。個別化血圧管理は標準管理に対し優位性を示さなかった。

items.title: Distal Vessel Occlusions in Acute Ischemic Stroke: Reframing Patient Selection and Reperfusion Strategies.
items.abstract: Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) has revolutionized the treatment of acute ischemic stroke because of large vessel occlusion (LVO), but distal and medium vessel occlusions (DMVOs) remain a gray zone. DMVOs account for a substantial proportion of ischemic strokes and can cause long-term disability or death despite often presenting with only mild to moderate symptoms. Their biologic and anatomic diversity-including small vessel caliber, variable perfusion territories, collateral dependence, and complex access pathways-creates distinct patterns of natural history, treatment responsiveness, and procedural risk compared with proximal LVO. Recent randomized trials and meta-analyses, conducted in broadly defined DMVO populations, did not demonstrate functional benefit of endovascular therapy (EVT) over best medical therapy (BMT) and observed numerically higher rates of intracranial hemorrhage with MT. These neutral results have fueled skepticism and guideline recommendations against routine EVT for DMVO stroke; however, they coexist with emerging trial data suggesting that treatment effects may depend on refined patient selection and optimized, distal-specific techniques, as well as with registry findings indicating that many patients with DMVO remain disabled despite BMT. In this narrative, we provide an interpretative synthesis of the available evidence to argue that the apparent discrepancy between biologic plausibility and neutral trial results reflects, at least in part, heterogeneity of DMVO definitions and phenotypes, limitations of severity and outcome scales, anatomy- and device-related safety constraints, and the unique mechanics and biology of small vessel thrombus retrieval rather than an absence of biologic efficacy. We highlight clinical, imaging, anatomic, and thrombus-related features which may help identify subgroups more likely to benefit from distal reperfusion and discuss emerging technical and pharmacologic strategies-including DMVO-specific device adaptations, intraarterial thrombolysis, and hybrid reperfusion approaches-which aim to reduce mechanical trauma while preserving the advantages of timely recanalization. Together, these considerations support a shift from viewing distal MT as a failed extension of proximal EVT to recognizing DMVO stroke as a distinct syndrome that requires tailored selection, techniques, and outcome assessment.
items.summary_ja:
背景：急性虚血性脳卒中における大血管閉塞（LVO）に対する機械的血栓除去術（MT）は治療を革新したが、遠位・中等血管閉塞（DMVO）は未解明の領域である。DMVOは虚血性脳卒中の多くを占め、軽度から中等度の症状でも長期障害や死亡を引き起こす可能性がある。  
方法：DMVOの生物学的・解剖学的多様性や治療反応性、手技リスクの違いを踏まえ、既存のランダム化試験やメタ解析、レジストリデータを総合的に検討し、患者選択や再灌流戦略の再考を試みた。  
結果：広義のDMVO患者を対象とした試験では、血管内治療（EVT）が最良の内科治療（BMT）に対し機能的利益を示さず、MTで頭蓋内出血率が高い傾向が見られた。しかし、患者選択の精緻化やDMVO特有の技術開発により、治療効果が向上する可能性が示唆された。  
結論：DMVOはLVOとは異なる独自の病態であり、従来の試験結果の中立性は定義の多様性や評価尺度の限界、解剖学的・機械的制約によるものである。臨床・画像・血栓特性に基づく患者選択と、DMVO専用の技術・薬理戦略の導入が必要であり、遠位血管閉塞に対する治療戦略の再構築が求められる。
items.summary_short_ja: 急性虚血性脳卒中における遠位・中等度血管閉塞（DMVO）は、症状が軽度でも重篤な障害を招くことが多く、治療戦略が未確立である。近年の試験では血管内治療（EVT）の有効性が示されず懸念があるが、患者選択や技術の最適化により効果が期待される。DMVOは近位閉塞とは異なる病態であり、専用デバイスや薬物療法を含む新たな治療法の開発が必要であると論じている。

items.title: Accuracy of Antibody Testing in Myasthenia Gravis: The ADAM Study.
items.abstract: Antibody testing has a pivotal role in the diagnosis of myasthenia gravis (MG). However, there are limited data on the accuracy of the different methods available for acetylcholine receptor (AChR) and muscle-specific kinase (MuSK) autoantibody (Ab) detection in a real-world setting. Our aim was to compare the diagnostic accuracy of in-house live cell-based assay (L-CBA), a commercially available fixed CBA (F-CBA), and an indirect ELISA in detecting AChR and MuSK antibodies in patients with suspected MG. Between July 2023 and December 2025, we prospectively recruited consecutive adult and pediatric patients with suspected MG across 4 Italian centers. Patients undergoing immunotherapy and those with incomplete diagnostic work-up or insufficient samples were excluded. Serum samples were tested blindly by L-CBA, F-CBA, and ELISA for AChR and MuSK antibodies. MG diagnosis was established independently based on neurologic examination, electrophysiologic studies, and/or sustained clinical response to pyridostigmine or corticosteroids as well as exclusion of other diagnoses. Diagnostic sensitivity, specificity, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were calculated using final diagnosis as the reference standard. Of the 327 included patients (median age 63 years, interquartile range 26, 52.9% female), 152 were diagnosed with MG and 175 with other diagnoses. For AChR antibodies, sensitivity was 71.7% (95% CI 63.8-78.7) for L-CBA, 69% (61.0-76.3) for F-CBA, and 63.8% (55.6-71.4) for ELISA, while specificity was 97.7% (94.2-99.3) for both CBAs vs 69.1% (61.7-75.9) for ELISA. ELISA showed lower concordance with CBAs and produced substantially more false positives (30.9%). For MuSK antibodies, sensitivity was similar (6.6 vs 7.2%) and specificity 100% across assays. ROC curve analysis confirmed higher diagnostic accuracy for L-CBA (AUC 0.85) compared with F-CBA (0.83) ( CBAs, especially live, demonstrated superior diagnostic performance for AChR antibody detection compared with ELISA, particularly in ocular MG. L-CBA showed a modest but significant diagnostic advantage over F-CBA, although fixed assays can be considered as a practical, nearly equivalent alternative, suitable for routine laboratories. By contrast, ELISA demonstrated lower specificity and should be interpreted cautiously. This study shows Class I data that L-CBA and F-CBA compare favorably with ELISA testing of AChR-Ab and MuSK-Ab, in the diagnosis of MG.
items.summary_ja:
背景：重症筋無力症（MG）の診断において抗体検査は重要だが、アセチルコリン受容体（AChR）および筋特異的キナーゼ（MuSK）自己抗体検出法の実際の精度データは限られている。  
方法：2023年7月から2025年12月までに、イタリアの4施設でMG疑い患者327名（成人・小児）を前向きに登録。免疫療法中や検査不十分な患者は除外。血清を用いて、ライブ細胞ベースアッセイ（L-CBA）、固定細胞ベースアッセイ（F-CBA）、間接ELISAでAChRおよびMuSK抗体を盲検検査し、最終診断を基準に感度・特異度・ROC曲線を評価。  
結果：152例がMGと診断。AChR抗体検出感度はL-CBAが71.7%、F-CBAが69%、ELISAが63.8%、特異度はL-CBA・F-CBAが97.7%、ELISAは69.1%であった。ELISAは偽陽性が多く、CBAsとの一致度も低かった。MuSK抗体は感度が低いが特異度は100%であった。ROC解析でL-CBA（AUC0.85）がF-CBA（0.83）よりやや優位。  
結論：L-CBAおよびF-CBAはELISAよりAChR抗体検出に優れ、特にL-CBAは診断精度が高い。固定法も実用的で日常検査に適する。一方、ELISAは特異度が低く慎重な解釈が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、重症筋無力症（MG）診断におけるアセチルコリン受容体（AChR）および筋特異的キナーゼ（MuSK）抗体検査の精度を比較した。生細胞ベースアッセイ（L-CBA）と固定CBA（F-CBA）は、間接ELISAよりも感度・特異度が高く、特にL-CBAが最も優れた診断性能を示した。ELISAは偽陽性が多く特異度が低いため注意が必要である。L-CBAとF-CBAはMG診断において信頼性の高い検査法である。

items.title: Clinical Significance of the Hyperintense Reperfusion Marker and Ocular Gadolinium Leakage After Thrombectomy: A Retrospective ETIS Study.
items.abstract: Despite successful recanalization after mechanical thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke, a substantial proportion of patients experience early neurologic deterioration or infarct progression. Early blood-brain barrier disruption, visualized on post-contrast fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (pcFLAIR) imaging as hyperintense acute reperfusion marker (HARM) or gadolinium leakage in ocular structures (GLOS), has been proposed as a marker of reperfusion injury, but its determinants and prognostic significance in thrombectomy cohorts remain uncertain. We aimed to evaluate whether HARM and GLOS are associated with poor clinical outcomes after mechanical thrombectomy. Secondary objectives included their association with poor radiologic outcomes and the identification of baseline and procedural predictors. We retrospectively analyzed data from the French Endovascular Treatment in Ischemic Stroke (ETIS) registry (2010-2021), including consecutive patients admitted to Versailles and Foch Hospital. All patients underwent mechanical thrombectomy at Foch Hospital and pcFLAIR imaging within 4-48 hours postgadolinium administration. Independent predictors of HARM and GLOS were identified through multivariable logistic regression, and their associations with early neurologic deterioration, poor 3-month functional outcome, infarct growth, and hemorrhagic transformation (HT) outcomes were evaluated. Among 229 patients (mean age 69.7 ± 14.9 years, 52.0% female), HARM was observed in 48.9% and GLOS in 41.9%. Overall, 60.3% of patients had either HARM or GLOS, including 29.3% with both markers, 19.7% with isolated HARM, and 11.4% with isolated GLOS. HARM was independently associated with early neurologic deterioration (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.45; 95% CI 1.33-8.95) and infarct growth (aOR 2.46; 95% CI 1.22-4.95), but not with HT or 3-month functional outcome. GLOS was not independently associated with clinical or radiologic outcomes. Older age, higher creatinine, and a shorter interval between the first and second FLAIR were common predictors of both HARM and GLOS, whereas single-pass recanalization was an independent predictor of HARM only. In this large thrombectomy cohort, HARM was independently associated with early neurologic deterioration and infarct progression after thrombectomy, supporting its role as an imaging marker of early blood-brain barrier disruption. GLOS, although frequent, was not independently associated with clinical or radiologic outcomes. Prospective studies with early and serial imaging are required to clarify the prognostic relevance of HARM. NCT03776877 (ETIS registry).
items.summary_ja:
背景：急性虚血性脳卒中に対する機械的血栓回収術後、再開通が成功しても早期神経症状悪化や梗塞進行が多く認められる。血液脳関門の早期障害を示す指標として、造影後FLAIR画像で観察される過強調再灌流マーカー（HARM）や眼球内ガドリニウム漏出（GLOS）が提案されているが、その予後的意義は不明である。  
方法：フランスETISレジストリ（2010-2021年）から、Foch病院で血栓回収術を受けた229例のpcFLAIR画像を用いてHARMおよびGLOSの発現率と臨床・画像予後との関連を後ろ向きに解析した。多変量ロジスティック回帰で予測因子を同定した。  
結果：HARMは48.9%、GLOSは41.9%に認められ、60.3%がいずれかのマーカーを有した。HARMは早期神経症状悪化（調整オッズ比3.45）および梗塞進行（同2.46）と独立して関連したが、出血性変化や3か月機能予後とは関連しなかった。GLOSは臨床・画像予後と独立した関連を示さなかった。高齢、クレアチニン高値、FLAIR間隔短縮が両者の共通予測因子であり、単回穿刺再開通はHARMの独立予測因子であった。  
結論：HARMは血栓回収術後の早期血液脳関門障害の画像マーカーとして有用であり、早期神経症状悪化や梗塞進行と関連する。一方、GLOSは頻度は高いものの予後指標としての独立性は認められなかった。今後、早期かつ連続的な画像評価による前向き研究が必要である。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、急性虚血性脳卒中に対する機械的血栓回収術後の早期神経悪化や梗塞進行と、血液脳関門破綻を示す画像マーカーであるHARM（高信号再灌流マーカー）およびGLOS（眼内ガドリニウム漏出）の関連を検討した。229例の解析で、HARMは早期神経悪化や梗塞拡大と独立して関連したが、GLOSは臨床・画像予後と関連しなかった。HARMは血液脳関門破綻の有用な指標と示唆される。

items.title: Comparison of Brain Age With Standard MRI Assessment for Dementia Risk Stratification in Subjective and Mild Cognitive Impairment.
items.abstract: Early dementia risk-stratification is crucial for timely intervention. Brain-predicted age difference (brain-PAD) derived from structural MRI reflects the gap between computer-estimated age and chronological age and has been linked to clinical progression to dementia. We evaluate whether brain-PAD has prognostic value for progression to dementia in subjective cognitive decline (SCD) and mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and whether brain-PAD provides added value beyond visual rating scales. This retrospective cohort study included patients with SCD and MCI with up to 10-year follow-up assessments from the Amsterdam Dementia Cohort and SCIENCe project. Brain-PAD was computed from baseline MRI using 2 pretrained methods. Cox proportional hazards models assessed the association between brain-PAD and risk of progression to dementia, controlling for age, sex, Mini Mental State Examination, and visual rating scales. We tested interactions between brain-PAD and baseline diagnosis to assess stage-specific value and evaluated the added value beyond amyloid status in a biomarker-available subset. The study included 799 patients (SCD 412, MCI 387; 39.4% female, 63.3 ± 8.0 years). During a median follow-up of 3.2 years, 235 (29.4%) progressed to dementia. Higher brain-PAD was associated with an increased risk of progression to dementia (hazard ratio [HR] 1.04, 95% CI 1.02-1.06) and improved model fit beyond visual ratings (χ MRI-derived brain-PAD predicts progression to dementia in memory clinic patients with SCD or MCI. In particular, brain-PAD provided additional predictive value to visual rating scales in patients with SCD.
items.summary_ja: 背景：認知機能の主観的低下（SCD）や軽度認知障害（MCI）における早期の認知症リスク層別化は、適切な介入のために重要である。方法：アムステルダム認知症コホートとSCIENCeプロジェクトのSCDおよびMCI患者799名（平均63.3歳）を対象に、最大10年間の追跡調査を行った。構造的MRIから脳予測年齢差（brain-PAD）を2つの事前学習モデルで算出し、Cox比例ハザードモデルで脳-PADと認知症進行リスクの関連を評価。年齢、性別、MMSE、視覚的評価スケールを調整し、診断群ごとの効果やアミロイド状態の影響も検討した。結果：中央値3.2年の追跡期間中、29.4％が認知症へ進行。脳-PADの上昇は認知症進行リスクの増加（HR 1.04）と有意に関連し、視覚的評価を超えた予測精度の向上に寄与した。特にSCD群で脳-PADの追加的予測価値が顕著であった。結論：MRI由来の脳-PADは、SCDおよびMCI患者の認知症進行予測に有用であり、視覚的評価スケールを補完する指標として臨床的価値が高い。
items.summary_short_ja: 本研究は、主観的認知低下（SCD）および軽度認知障害（MCI）患者における脳年齢差（brain-PAD）が認知症進行予測に有用かを検討した。799名を最大10年追跡し、brain-PADは視覚的評価を超えて認知症リスクの予測力を示した。特にSCD患者での追加的な予測価値が明らかとなり、早期介入のためのリスク層別化に有効であることが示された。

items.title: Acute Attack Treatment Escalation and Subsequent Relapse Risk in Pediatric Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein Antibody-Associated Disease.
items.abstract: Acute treatment for myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD) includes high-dose IV methylprednisolone (IVMP), with escalation to IV immunoglobulin (IVIG) and/or plasma exchange (PLEX) based on severity or incomplete response. We evaluated whether escalation at first attack influences disease course. We conducted a retrospective single-center study of pediatric-onset MOGAD evaluated between 2015 and 2024. Patients were classified to (1) steroid-only or (2) steroid-plus (IVMP followed by IVIG, PLEX, or both). Outcomes included early (≤1 year) and overall relapses. Time-to-event analyses used Kaplan-Meier and adjusted Cox regression. Ninety-six of 114 patients were included (58% female; median age 6.3 years [interquartile range (IQR) 4.1-11.3]; median follow-up 3.2 years [IQR 1.4-6.1]). Sixty-eight (71%) received steroid-only therapy and 28 (29%) escalation therapy. Relapses were more frequent with steroid-only treatment at 1 year (28% vs 4%; relative risk [RR] 7.80; 95% CI 1.10-55.3) and at final follow-up (43% vs 11%; RR 3.98; 95% CI 1.33-11.93). Escalation therapy was associated with reduced relapse risk (adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 0.25; 95% CI 0.07-0.85;  Acute immunotherapy escalation was associated with lower early and mid-term relapses, suggesting the first attack may represent a therapeutic opportunity to influence disease trajectory.
items.summary_ja: 背景：ミエリンオリゴデンドロサイト糖タンパク抗体関連疾患（MOGAD）の急性発作治療は、高用量静脈内メチルプレドニゾロン（IVMP）が基本であり、重症例や反応不十分な場合は免疫グロブリン静注（IVIG）や血漿交換（PLEX）への治療強化が行われる。方法：2015～2024年に小児発症MOGAD患者114例中96例を対象に、初回発作時の治療をステロイド単独群（IVMPのみ）と治療強化群（IVMP後にIVIG、PLEXまたは両方）に分け、1年以内および全期間の再発率を後ろ向きに解析した。結果：ステロイド単独群（68例）は治療強化群（28例）に比べ、1年以内の再発率が28%対4%（相対リスク7.80）、最終フォローアップ時も43%対11%（相対リスク3.98）と有意に高かった。治療強化は再発リスクを有意に低減（調整ハザード比0.25）した。結論：初回発作時の免疫療法強化は早期および中期の再発を減少させ、疾患経過に影響を与える治療機会となり得ることが示唆された。
items.summary_short_ja: 小児期発症のミエリンオリゴデンドロサイト糖タンパク抗体関連疾患（MOGAD）において、初回急性期治療でステロイド単独療法と免疫グロブリン投与や血漿交換を加えた治療の効果を比較した。28%のステロイド単独群で1年以内に再発したのに対し、エスカレーション治療群は4%にとどまり、再発リスクが有意に低減した。初回発作時の積極的治療が疾患経過改善に寄与する可能性を示唆する。
